title: Genspark: approved research and Word-document collaboration in Teams
availability: AI teammate: Frontier-program access required by the source
overview: Microsoft documents Genspark in Teams conversations for research, summarization and task execution, with Word-document collaboration and user approval or rejection of actions. The source also says Genspark calls sub-agents internally.
published_facts: Genspark can participate in Teams one-to-one and group conversations for research and task execution.
Users can create and collaborate on Word documents from a Genspark conversation.
The integration supports human approval or rejection before proceeding and tracks activity through Agent 365.
Genspark can call one or more sub-agents; the source does not establish unbounded dynamic spawning.

sources.title: Ecosystem partner agents available in Agent 365 - Genspark
sources.verification: Primary page and Genspark section fetched and read directly.

a365_relationship: Direct: Microsoft lists the Genspark Agent 365 integration. Its AI teammate category has a Frontier-program availability caveat.
intent: Research a topic requested in Teams and create a collaborative Word document only after the proposed action is approved.
actors: Teams user, Genspark agent and approving user; simplified local Agent and Reviewer roles.
published_outcome: Documented research, Word collaboration and human-in-the-loop capabilities, not independently observed customer productivity measurements.

actions.description: Research the topic requested in the Teams conversation.
Prepare the proposed Word-document action from the research.
Obtain approval before executing the proposed action.
Create the approved document for collaboration.

local_assumptions: The role handoffs and Boolean approval predicate formalize the published human-in-the-loop behavior; no exact Genspark protocol is asserted.
The local declared environment assumes the necessary Teams and Word capabilities and entitlement.
A separate stress variant introduces unbounded dynamic spawning to exercise UNKNOWN; this is not claimed to be Genspark's actual topology.
limitations: SkillC cannot prove research correctness, citation quality or the quality of generated Word content.
Frontier entitlement and effective document permissions are not observed by the offline runner.
Dynamic participant creation outside the checker fragment yields UNKNOWN rather than certification.
The runtime reviewer is host-supplied fixture identity, not an authenticated live Genspark user.
